Friday Breeze Ride from Ealing

Ealing, United Kingdom · Ealing · Social · Road

Women / trans / femme

Friday Breeze Ride from Ealing is a social and road group ride in Ealing, United Kingdom. It rolls every Friday at 9:30 am local time from Ealing Town Hall. Pace: varies by ride; each listing gives distance and pace.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: varies by ride; each listing gives distance and pace.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Friday Breeze Ride from Ealing group ride

Free rides for women from Ealing, run by volunteer Breeze Champions and ride leaders. Rides range from short park rides to long ones that use the train, and each is listed with its own distance and pace. The group has 466 members.
